_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in the keys you actually have. `kind` is `ark` (Volcengine Ark, the two surfaces below) or `openai` (any OpenAI-compatible image API, e.g. a third-party relay). `refs_mode` decides how reference images travel: `json` (data URLs in the body — Ark and most relays), `multipart` (a real /images/edits upload), or `none`.

openai-relay.label: 第三方 OpenAI 兼容（示例）
